about: How other players' and bots' sounds are mixed in Sector Nine (same numbers as SOUND_MIX in index.html; qa/qa_sound.js checks they match). Within 'near' metres a sound always plays (hard safety cap per window only); within 'close' metres not even that cap applies (only 'absCap' per window, far above any real fight); between 'near' and 'range' sources share 'budget' sounds per 'window' seconds (far ones thin out first); beyond 'range' nothing plays. Falloff: gain = ref / (ref + roll * (distance - ref)), full volume inside ref. prio: 3 = enemy gunfire, 2 = footsteps / reloads / whizzes, 1 = impacts and the rest (lower prio stops earlier when the hard cap is reached: prio 3 at 100%, 2 at 75%, 1 at 50% of hardCap). voices: per-voice output volume (overrides the gun voice's own; someone else's gun plays at 0.8x of it before distance falloff) and layers (railCharge: the Helix recharge whine, 'delay' s after the shot, 'remote' = extra factor when it is someone else's gun).
